1-s3.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 3. Скажи, сколько времён года в году, назови их и скажи, отличаются ли они в России и Великобритании.
steps: There are four seasons in a year: winter, spring, summer and autumn. They are the same in Russia and in Britain, but the weather is different.
1-s3.answer: four seasons — winter, spring, summer, autumn; the same, but the weather is different

2-s3.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 3. Скажи, когда начинаются лето и зима в России и в Великобритании.
steps: In Russia summer begins in June and winter begins in December. In Britain summer begins in May and winter begins in November.
2-s3.answer: Russia — June / December; Britain — May / November

3-s3.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 3. Прочитай предложения и угадай времена года.
steps: a) summer; b) spring; c) winter.

4-s3.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 3. Вспомни стихотворение или песню о временах года.
steps: Spring is green, summer is bright, autumn is yellow, winter is white.
4-s3.answer: Spring is green, summer is bright, autumn is yellow, winter is white.

5-s3.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 3. Составь пять предложений об осени и весне из данных слов.
steps: It is often very warm in April. It is usually terribly cold in late autumn. It isn't always very hot in September. It is sometimes very dry in March. It isn't usually very nice in October.
5-s3.answer: It is often / usually / sometimes warm, cold, dry, nice in April, September, March, October.

6-s4.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 6, с. 4. Спой песню «What's the weather like today?».
steps: Слушаем запись и поём песню о погоде вместе с классом.

7-s5.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 7, с. 5. Прочитай текст и узнай, что Миша и Катя думают о зиме.
steps: Misha loves winter: it is beautiful, the sun is bright, the streets and trees are white, you can ski, skate and sledge, play snowballs, and there are winter holidays, Christmas and New Year.
Katya doesn't like winter: it is cold and dark, the days are short, and she has to wear warm clothes.
7-s5.answer: Misha likes winter (sports, holidays); Katya doesn't (cold, dark, short days).

look-read-and-remember-s5.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, с. 5. Прочитай и запомни выражения.
steps: It's cold / warm / hot / cool. It's raining / snowing. The sun is shining. It's windy / cloudy / sunny / frosty. What's the weather like today?
look-read-and-remember-s5.answer: выражения о погоде: it's cold, warm, hot, windy, sunny; it's raining / snowing

8-s6.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 8, с. 6. Расскажи о любом времени года и скажи, почему оно тебе нравится или нет.
steps: My favourite season is summer. I like it because it's warm and sunny. I can play outside, swim in the river and ride a bike. The trees are green and there are a lot of flowers. In summer we have holidays and the days are long.
8-s6.answer: My favourite season is … I like it because …

9-s6.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 9, с. 6. Дополни диалог и разыграй его.
steps: Al: Hello, Fred. How are you? Fred: I'm fine, thank you. Al: What shall we do today? Fred: Let's go to the park. Al: What's the weather like? Fred: It's warm and sunny. Al: OK, let's go.
9-s6.answer: Hello — I'm fine — Let's go to the park — It's warm and sunny — OK

10-s6.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 10, с. 6. Напиши три вопроса с данными вопросительными словами.
steps: When does it rain in Moscow? Where does it often rain in autumn? Does it ever snow in Africa? When does it usually snow in Russia? Does it usually rain in October?
10-s6.answer: When does it rain…? Where does it snow…? Does it …?

11-s6.condition: Round-up, Lesson 1, упр. 11, с. 6. Составь вопросы о любимом времени года и задай их другу.
steps: What is your favourite season? Why do you like it? Does it often rain in this season? What colours can you see in this season? What's the weather like in your favourite season? What do you do in this season?
11-s6.answer: What is your favourite season? Why? What's the weather like? What do you do?

1-s7.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 7. Назови предметы одежды в каждой группе.
steps: 1. sandals, shoes, slippers, boots. 2. sweater, jacket, scarf, mittens, gloves. 3. T-shirt, shorts, cap. 4. skirt, dress, blouse, tights. 5. trousers, hat, jacket, jeans.
1-s7.answer: обувь; тёплая одежда; летняя одежда; одежда для девочек; брюки, шляпа, джинсы

2-s7.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 7. Посмотри на картинку и скажи, во что одеты люди.
steps: Mr Smith is wearing a long coat. Mrs Smith is wearing a hat and a long coat. Jill is wearing a dress. Ann is wearing a skirt, a shirt and a jacket. Nick is wearing a cap, a jacket, mittens and boots. Tom is wearing a cap, a jacket, trousers and boots. Mr Black is wearing a sweater, trousers, a jacket and shoes.
2-s7.answer: … is wearing a coat / hat / dress / skirt / jacket / cap / boots

3-s8.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 8. Прочитай вопросы и выбери верные ответы.
steps: a — c; b — b; c — d; d — b.

4-s8.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 8. Игра: опиши одежду одноклассника, остальные угадывают.
steps: A: He is wearing a cap, a jacket, mittens and boots. B: It's Mark! A: Yes, it is. — A: She is wearing a blue dress. B: It's Olga! A: No, it isn't.

5-s8.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 8. Расскажи стихотворение об одежде.
steps: Put on your shoes, put on your jacket, put on your scarf, put on your hat — let's go outside, hurry up!
5-s8.answer: Put on your shoes / jacket / scarf / hat — let's go outside!

6-s8.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 8. Прочитай текст и найди, как выбрать правильную одежду.
steps: When you buy clothes, try them on. Make sure they are your size, they suit you and you like their colour.
6-s8.answer: try them on; your size; they suit you; you like the colour

7-s9.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 7, с. 9. Напиши, какая одежда подходит для ситуаций.
steps: A race — T-shirt, shorts, cap, trainers. A birthday party — a dress or a suit. A rainy summer day — jeans, a jacket, boots. A cold winter day — a warm coat, mittens, a hat, boots.
7-s9.answer: race — sports clothes; party — dress / suit; rainy day — jacket, boots; winter — coat, mittens, hat

8-s9.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 8, с. 9. Напиши, во что ты сейчас одет и почему.
steps: I'm at home, so I'm wearing a T-shirt, shorts and slippers. It's warm at home.

9-s9.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 9, с. 9. Обсудите в группах ситуации об одежде.
steps: I'd like to buy new jeans and a nice skirt. My mum usually wears a skirt, a blouse and shoes; my dad prefers trousers and shirts. My favourite colours are blue, white and yellow. I'm not very interested in fashion. I think pupils should wear school uniforms.
9-s9.answer: I'd like to buy…; my parents wear…; my favourite colours…; school uniform — yes / no

10-s10.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 10, с. 10. a) Прочитай диалог в магазине; b) составь и разыграй похожий.
steps: a) Jane asks for a pair of jeans, size 36, light blue, tries them on, they suit her, she takes them and asks about the price.

b) — Excuse me. — Can I help you? — I'd like a pair of trainers. — What size? — 38. — What colour? — Black. — Here's a nice pair. — Can I try them on? — They look great on you. — Thank you, I'll take them. How much are they?
10-s10.answer: I'd like a pair of… — What size / colour? — Can I try them on? — I'll take them.

11-s10.condition: Round-up, Lesson 2, упр. 11, с. 10. Найди картинку с людьми в разной одежде и закончи вопросы.
steps: Are they wearing bright clothes? Are they wearing light or warm clothes? They are wearing trousers, aren't they? What are they wearing? What colour is the girl's dress?
11-s10.answer: Are they wearing…? What are they wearing? …, aren't they?

1-s11.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 11. Посмотри на картинки и назови членов семей.
steps: The Greens: a grandmother, a mother, a father, an aunt, an uncle, a sister, two brothers and a cousin. The Smiths: grandparents, parents, a sister and two brothers. The Adams: a husband and a wife.
1-s11.answer: the Greens — большая семья; the Smiths — grandparents, parents, children; the Adams — husband and wife

2-s12.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 12. Скажи, большая ли у тебя семья и сколько у тебя бабушек и дедушек.
steps: I come from a large family. I have got a mother, a father, a brother, two grandmothers and two grandfathers.
2-s12.answer: I come from a large / small family. I have got … grandparents.

3-s12.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 12. Дополни предложения названиями профессий.
steps: 1. a doctor; 2. a teacher; 3. pilots; 4. pupils; 5. a cosmonaut.
3-s12.answer: a doctor, a teacher, pilots, pupils, a cosmonaut

4-s12.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 12. Назови родственников Элис и их профессии.
steps: Alice's mother is a doctor. Her father is an engineer. Her aunt is a teacher. Her uncle is a driver. Her brother is a pupil.
4-s12.answer: mother — doctor, father — engineer, aunt — teacher, uncle — driver, brother — pupil

5-s12.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 12. Дополни диалог ответами на вопросы Моники и разыграй его.
steps: Joan: My name is Joan. Monica: Glad to meet you. Joan: Glad to meet you too. I am ten. Monica: I am ten too. Joan: It's great here. Monica: But my father isn't here, he is still in London. Joan: I miss my family too.
5-s12.answer: My name is… — I am ten — It's great here — my father is in London

6-s13.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 6, с. 13. Вспомни стихотворение о семье.
steps: This is daddy, this is mummy, this is sister, this is brother, this is me, me, me — and my whole family.
6-s13.answer: This is daddy, mummy, sister, brother, me — my whole family.

7-s13.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 7, с. 13. Прочитай текст о Роберте и скажи, сколько у него родственников.
steps: Bob has got seven relatives: his uncle, his cousin, his grandmother May, his baby brother Jack, his father, his mother and his grandmother Pamela.
7-s13.answer: seven relatives: uncle, cousin, two grandmothers, baby brother, father, mother

8-s14.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 8, с. 14. Найди и прочитай предложения из текста упр. 7, которые подходят к фотографиям.
steps: This is David and Frank and me. David is on the right, Frank is on the left. This is my grandmother's photo, her name is May. This is my baby brother Jack. These are two pictures of my father — here we are together in the mountains where we go skiing.
8-s14.answer: Предложения о фото: David and Frank, grandmother May, baby brother Jack, father in the mountains

9-s14.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 9, с. 14. По фотографиям упр. 7 скажи, во что одеты родственники Боба и почему.
steps: His uncle is wearing a blue shirt because it's summer. His cousin is wearing a T-shirt. His grandmother May is wearing a red blouse because she likes bright colours. His baby brother is wearing a T-shirt because he is at home. His father is wearing a cap, a sports suit and boots because he is skiing.
9-s14.answer: shirt / T-shirt — summer; blouse — bright colours; sports suit — skiing

10-s14.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 10, с. 14. Расскажи о своей семье.
steps: My name is Tanya. I come from a large family: a mother, a father, a brother, a grandmother and a grandfather. My mother is a doctor, my father is an engineer, my brother is a student. I have aunts, uncles and three cousins. My grandparents like gardening. My family is very friendly.
10-s14.answer: My name is … I have got … My mother is a … My family is friendly.

11-s14.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 11, с. 14. Принеси фотографию и расскажи о людях на ней.
steps: This is the Smirnov family. There are grandparents, a mother, a father, two brothers and a sister. Mother is a teacher, she is 39. Father is a doctor, he is 40. Dima is a student, Sasha is 13 and goes to school, Lena is 7.
11-s14.answer: This is the … family. There are … Mother is a … Father is a …

12-s14.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 12, с. 14. Составь и запиши вопросы о семье друга.
steps: Is your family large or small? How many people are there in your family? Have you got any brothers or sisters? Have you got grandparents? Have you got cousins? Is your family friendly?
12-s14.answer: Is your family large? How many…? Have you got brothers, sisters, grandparents, cousins?

13-s14.condition: Round-up, Lesson 3, упр. 13, с. 14. Дополни диалог из упр. 5 письменно.
steps: Joan: My name is Joan. Monica: Glad to meet you. Joan: Glad to meet you too. I am ten years old. Monica: I am ten too. Joan: It's great here. Monica: But my father is not here. He is still in London. Joan: I miss my family too.

1-s15.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 15. Назови всё, что видишь на картинках (there is / there are).
steps: There is some cheese, tea, jam, lemonade, milk and porridge on the table. There are some toasts, bananas, eggs, carrots and apples on the table.
1-s15.answer: There is some cheese / tea / jam / milk / porridge; there are some toasts / bananas / eggs / carrots

2-s15.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 15. Назови нужные продукты для каждого блюда.
steps: Breakfast — porridge, milk, an apple. Sandwiches — sausages, eggs, bread. Dinner — fish, salad, soup, chicken, potatoes. Tea — biscuits, sweets, chocolate. Supper — potatoes, meat, salad, rice.
2-s15.answer: porridge, milk; sausages, eggs; fish, soup, chicken; biscuits, sweets; meat, rice

look-read-remember-s15.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, с. 15. Запомни правило There is / There are.
steps: There is + единственное число или неисчисляемое: There is some milk. There are + множественное: There are some apples. Вопрос: Is there any…? Are there any…? Отрицание: There isn't any… / There aren't any…
look-read-remember-s15.answer: there is (some milk) / there are (some apples); any в вопросах и отрицаниях

3-s16.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 16. Скажи, что ты и твои родственники любите есть каждый день.
steps: I like to eat apples, bananas, salads and sweets every day. My parents like chicken, fish and potatoes. My brother likes cakes, meat, cucumbers and sausages.
3-s16.answer: I like to eat … every day; my parents like …; my brother likes …

4-s16.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 16. Скажи, можешь ли ты сходить за покупками для мамы; составь список и диалог.
steps: I can go to the shop and buy everything mum needs. Shopping list: milk, bread, oranges, potatoes, sausages.
A: Have you got any milk? B: Yes, we have. A: Have you got any oranges? B: No, we haven't. A: Have you got any sausages? B: Yes, we have.
4-s16.answer: Shopping list + диалог: Have you got any…? — Yes, we have / No, we haven't.

5-s16.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 5, с. 16. Вспомни стихотворение или песню о еде.
steps: What do I like? I like ice cream. She likes sweets. I like biscuits. He likes cheese. I like coffee. She likes tea. I like you. Do you like me?
5-s16.answer: I like ice cream, she likes sweets, he likes cheese…

6-s16.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 6, с. 16. Послушай и спой песню «I like food».
steps: Смысл песни: я люблю еду и много есть — хлеб, джем, мясо, рыбу, пирожные, яйца, чипсы, картошку, горошек, капусту, помидоры, шоколад, сыр, тосты с маслом… Слушаем и поём.

7-s17.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 7, с. 17. Прочитай текст и скажи, в чём разница между полным английским и континентальным завтраком.
steps: A full English breakfast: cereal, fruit juice, bacon and eggs, tomatoes, toast with marmalade, tea or coffee with milk. A continental breakfast: only bread or toast with marmalade and a cup of tea or coffee.
7-s17.answer: full — cereal, juice, bacon, eggs, toast, tea; continental — toast and coffee

8-s17.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 8, с. 17. Скажи, что ты ешь на завтрак и отличается ли он от английского.
steps: I usually have porridge or fried eggs and tea for breakfast. It is different from the full English breakfast — I don't eat bacon and cereal.
8-s17.answer: I usually have … for breakfast. It is different / like the continental breakfast.

9-s17.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 9, с. 17. Прочитай диалоги, составь свои и разыграй.
steps: In the shop: — Have you got any bananas? — Sorry, no. I've got apples, oranges and pears. — Could I have some oranges? — Of course. Anything else? — No, thanks.
Cooking dinner: — I'd like to cook potatoes with meat. Have we got any potatoes? — No, we haven't. — Then go and buy some, please.
9-s17.answer: Have you got any…? — Sorry, no / Yes. — Could I have…?

10-s18.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 10, с. 18. Заполни пропуски some / any.
steps: 1. some; 2. any; 3. some; 4. some; 5. any; 6. some; 7. any.
10-s18.answer: some, any, some, some, any, some, any

11-s18.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 11, с. 18. Скажи, что ты любишь и не любишь есть на ужин летом и зимой.
steps: In summer I like salad with meat and I don't like soup for dinner. In winter I like potatoes and sausages and hot tea or cocoa.
11-s18.answer: In summer I like … In winter I like …

12-s18.condition: Round-up, Lesson 4, упр. 12, с. 18. Составь пять вопросов с there is / are о еде в холодильнике одноклассника.
steps: Is there any meat in your fridge? Are there any vegetables? Is there any jam? Are there any carrots? Is there any cheese?
12-s18.answer: Is there any meat / jam / cheese…? Are there any vegetables / carrots…?

1-s19.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 19. Назови птиц и животных по заданиям.
steps: Domestic animals: cat, pig, cow, hen, duck, horse, dog. Animals that can swim: duck, horse, cat. Wild animals of Africa: lion, hippo, giraffe, elephant. Animals with long necks / tails: giraffe, cow, monkey, horse. Fast animals: hare, fox, tiger. Strong animals: lion, tiger, horse. Animals that can change colour: chameleon. The king of animals: lion.
1-s19.answer: cat, pig, cow, hen, duck, horse, dog; lion, hippo, giraffe, elephant; hare, fox, tiger; chameleon; lion

2-s19.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 19. Подумай и напиши ответы на вопросы (сравнение животных).
steps: I think the dog is cleverer because it knows commands. The fish is shorter — crocodiles can be 3 metres long. The horse is more beautiful. The elephant is bigger than the bear. The monkey is funnier because it can do different tricks.
2-s19.answer: cleverer, shorter, more beautiful, bigger, funnier — с объяснением

3-s19.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 3, с. 19. Посмотри на картинки и найди, что неправильно.
steps: The wolf doesn't eat leaves — it eats meat. The white bear can't live in hot countries — it likes cold weather, and bears don't eat frogs.
3-s19.answer: wolves eat meat, not leaves; polar bears live in the cold

4-s19.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 19. Прослушай запись и ответь на вопросы.
steps: The most popular pets in all countries are cats and dogs. Yes, people sometimes take care of wild cubs left in the woods without their mothers.
4-s19.answer: cats and dogs; yes, people help little wild animals

5-s20.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 5, с. 20. Игра: задай другу вопросы о его любимом животном и угадай его.
steps: What colour is your favourite animal? What does it like to do? What does it like to eat and drink? Where does it live? What does it look like? Is it big or small?
5-s20.answer: What colour…? What does it eat? Where does it live? What does it look like?

6-s20.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 6, с. 20. Вспомни стихи и песни о животных.
steps: Например, песня-игра «Who took the cookie from the cookie jar?»: Who took the cookie? — The panda took the cookie! — Who, me? — Yes, you! — Not me! — Then who? — The rabbit! …
6-s20.answer: Поём «Who took the cookie from the cookie jar?» или другую песню о животных.

7-s20.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 7, с. 20. Прочитай текст и скажи, почему птицы и животные перемещаются из страны в страну.
steps: Some birds and animals move from country to country because when summer is over it becomes cold and there is no food — birds can't find food under the snow.
7-s20.answer: because it gets cold and there is no food in winter

8-s20.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 8, с. 20. Прочитай тексты и соотнеси их с картинками.

9-s22.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 9, с. 22. Опиши своё любимое животное, друзья угадывают.
steps: My favourite animal is orange with a big mane. It eats meat because it is a wild animal. It lives in Africa. It is strong and fast. — It's a lion.

10-s22.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 10, с. 22. Напиши, нравятся ли тебе книги, фильмы и передачи о животных и почему.
steps: I like books, films and TV programmes about animals because they are interesting. I learn about their food, homes and habits from them.
10-s22.answer: I like … about animals because I learn about their life.

11-s22.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 11, с. 22. Напиши своё мнение о содержании диких животных дома.
steps: I don't like the idea of keeping wild animals as pets. Wild animals need freedom and their real home in nature.
11-s22.answer: I don't think it's good — wild animals need freedom.

12-s22.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 12, с. 22. Напиши вопросы другу о его любимом животном.
steps: What colour is your favourite animal? What does it like to do? What does it like to eat? What does it drink? Where does it live? What does it look like?
12-s22.answer: What colour…? What does it eat? Where does it live? What does it look like?

13-s22.condition: Round-up, Lesson 5, упр. 13, с. 22. Дополни предложения для обсуждения в классе.
steps: Wolves are bigger than hares, aren't they? What animal is bigger than a bear? What is the fastest animal? What animal has the longest neck? Lions can't swim, can they?
13-s22.answer: …, aren't they? What is the fastest animal? …, can they?

1-s22.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 1, с. 22. По таблице скажи, когда англичане отмечают праздники.
steps: Bonfire Night is on 5 November. Remembrance Day is on 11 November. Christmas Day is on 25 December. New Year's Day is on 1 January. St Valentine's Day is on 14 February. St Patrick's Day is on 17 March. April Fools' Day is on 1 April. Easter is in late March or April.
1-s22.answer: 5 Nov, 11 Nov, 25 Dec, 1 Jan, 14 Feb, 17 Mar, 1 Apr, Easter — March / April

2-s23.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 2, с. 23. Соотнеси праздники с датами.
2-s23.answer: D, E, G, A, C, H, F, B

3-s23.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 3, с. 23. Составь предложения о зимних каникулах (was / were).
steps: I wasn't at school last Christmas. My mother wasn't in the country last month. My friend was at the stadium last December. My parents weren't at the sports ground last month. My granny was at home last Christmas.
3-s23.answer: was / wasn't / were / weren't + место + last Christmas / month / December

4-s24.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 4, с. 24. Прослушай запись и скажи, какой праздник отмечала Эвелин 25 декабря и какой подарок получила.
steps: Evelyn celebrated Christmas. She got a beautiful doll with large blue eyes and a book.
4-s24.answer: Christmas; a doll and a book

5-s24.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 5, с. 24. Спой любимую песню об английских праздниках.
steps: Например, «We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year».
5-s24.answer: We wish you a Merry Christmas…

6-s24.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 6, с. 24. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: America is a young country with old and new traditions. Americans like new ideas and old things. Its own holidays are Thanksgiving Day and Memorial Day. Memorial Day is on the last Monday of May.
6-s24.answer: a young country; new ideas and old things; Thanksgiving, Memorial Day; the last Monday of May

7-s25.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 7, с. 25. Допиши диалог и разыграй его по ролям.
steps: — Hi, Sylvia! How are you? — Hello! I'm fine, thank you. And you? — I'm fine too. Where were you on holiday? — I visited my granny in the country. We skied and skated. — Did you celebrate Christmas? — We celebrated the New Year. Our friends visited us, we sang songs and danced.
7-s25.answer: Hi — I'm fine — I visited my granny — We celebrated the New Year

8-s25.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 8, с. 25. a) Расскажи о Дне смеха; b) хорошая ли это традиция?
steps: a) April Fools' Day is on 1 April. People play funny tricks and jokes to make each other laugh.
b) I think it's a good tradition — it's a funny holiday. But some jokes are not funny at all.
8-s25.answer: 1 April, tricks and jokes; a good tradition, but jokes must be kind

9-s25.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 9, с. 25. Расскажи другу о самом интересном празднике в Америке, Англии и России.
steps: St Valentine's Day is the most interesting holiday. People celebrate it in America, England and Russia on 14 February. People send Valentine cards to those they love. Children make valentines for their friends and teachers.
9-s25.answer: St Valentine's Day — 14 February, Valentine cards

10-s25.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 10, с. 25. Заполни пропуски was / were.
steps: 1. were; 2. was, were; 3. was; 4. were.

11-s25.condition: Round-up, Lesson 6, упр. 11, с. 25. Заполни пропуски в тексте глаголами в прошедшем времени.
steps: was, gave, died, called, began, got, were, sent, put.
11-s25.answer: was, gave, died, called, began, got, were, sent, put

1-s26.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 1, с. 26. Назови виды спорта на рисунках.
steps: skiing, skating, football, badminton, basketball, tennis, swimming.
1-s26.answer: skiing, skating, football, badminton, basketball, tennis, swimming

2-s26.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 2, с. 26. Опроси друзей и составь список: во что умеют играть, что любят смотреть, чему научились за год.
steps: My friend can play football and badminton and can ski. My friend's family like to watch skating and swimming. Now my friend can play basketball, but he couldn't last year.
2-s26.answer: My friend can play …; likes to watch …; can … now, but couldn't last year

3-s26.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 3, с. 26. Задай другу вопросы о прошлых выходных.
steps: Who did you play football with last Sunday? Where were you last summer? When did you visit your grandparents? Why did you miss your training? What game did you watch? How often did you swim? Where did you ski last weekend?
3-s26.answer: Who…? Where…? When…? Why…? What…? How often…? — did you … last …

4-s27.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 4, с. 27. Вспомни, когда ты в последний раз это делал.
steps: I played hide-and-seek last week. I went to the sports ground yesterday. I went to the seaside two years ago. I went skiing last winter. I looked at the stars a month ago. I swam in the river last summer.
4-s27.answer: I … last week / yesterday / two years ago / last winter / last summer

5-s27.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 5, с. 27. Спой песню или расскажи стихотворение о природе.
steps: Rain on the grass, rain on the tree, rain on the house, but not on me!
5-s27.answer: Rain on the grass, rain on the tree, rain on the house, but not on me!

6-s27.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 6, с. 27. Прослушай и спой песню «The Bear Went Over the Mountain».
steps: Смысл: медведь перешёл через гору, чтобы посмотреть, что он увидит, — а увидел только другую сторону горы. Слушаем и поём.
6-s27.answer: Поём песню о медведе и горе.

7-s27.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 7, с. 27. Прочитай рассказ «Кузнечик и Муравей» и скажи, в чём его мораль.
steps: The moral: you must work hard like the Ant and prepare for winter, so that you are not hungry later.
7-s27.answer: Work hard and prepare for the future, like the Ant.
